decision: No runtime policy change selected: historical loop did not reproduce and matched controls show no convergence gain.
method: Within-invocation duplicates key invocation ID, function, exact arguments; result duplicates additionally require identical successful bytes. Fresh-stage reads remain separate. Full-file status compares returned bytes with the unchanged frozen snapshot. Range/partial reads are labeled, never automatically judged unnecessary. Provider-reported zero prices are not an invoice or a claim of free use.

independent_quality_adjudication.historical_recall: Unknown; historical assignments were unseeded and no comprehensive independent defect oracle exists.

limitations: Current production prompts were regenerated, not byte-identical replay of the original requests. Redaction corrupts captured stage JSON and changes some captured result identities.
Exact frozen Git source and complete captured shared context were retained privately; historical requests/captures/source were not published.
No original provider request bodies or original native CLI version are present in the frozen capture.

Synthetic controls use explicit singleton assignment batches to exclude planner effects; the complete ReviewInvestigation lifecycle runs, while outer pipeline routing, synthesis and repo-wide fanout are not exercised.
No native compaction was induced by the loopback retention test; it tests ordinary request-time history preservation.
Two repeats per synthetic condition and one historical pair per task cannot establish absence of intermittent loops or a general speed improvement.
Native reported prices were zero; actual invoice cost remains unknown.
